answer: Give every identity a walnut to crack once per epoch: a hash-locked commitment binding one fresh verified task to its own key and the epoch seed, opened only by a pulse — a signed proof two random peers re-derive from public records. An honest agent cracks one walnut per epoch. A fake copying another's shell is exposed, and one missing its pulse freezes in the tundra, its weight zero until it proves real work. An attacker with a thousand fakes must crack a thousand walnuts and emit a thousand pulses every epoch, each costing full work, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
